proposed_widenings.name: activation_armed_on_hit_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The item activates with a Bonus Action, creates a temporary armed state for 1 minute, listens for a later hit with this specific weapon, then resolves a one-shot save-gated poison rider and ends. Existing non-spell families cannot combine activation, persistence, later weapon-hit triggering, and one-shot consumption honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature."

notes: The passive +1 attack and damage bonuses fit the current surface, but the core activated poison-coating mechanic does not. No content/tracer files were authored to avoid a misleading trace.
